articles.summary: HOTEL101-BANGKOK IS SET TO HAVE APPROX. 770 ROOMS TO RISE IN AN 8,336 SQM SITE ALONG PHAHON YOTHIN ROAD, NEAR DON MUEANG INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT AND BESIDE THE YAEK KOR POR AOR BTS STATION. HOTEL101-BANGKOK IS EXPECTED TO GENERATE APPROX. 1.925 BILLION BAHT (US$58 MILLION) IN SALES REVENUE
articles.title: Hotel101 Global Announces Definitive Binding Agreements Signed for the Development of Hotel101 in Bangkok, Thailand
